sentences.en: I interviewed a lady who works to protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位致力于环保工作的女士。

sentences.en: I have to have an interview before taking the examination.
sentences.zh: 在考试前我必须先面试。

sentences.en: The minister refused to give an interview to the reporters.
sentences.zh: 部长拒绝了记者的采访请求。

senses.zh: 面谈，面试 - 采访，交谈 - 会谈，会见 -
